answer: A slow-climb reputation knoll: every agent starts at the foot and can only rise by doing verified work that peers attest over many epochs. A forger who tries to wander in with a hundred fresh clones finds each one stuck at the base, earning nothing until it has done real work. Clones that spiral up together get caught when their attestations form a closed loop with no outside peers, and the whole loop is slashed. Faking one identity costs months of honest work; faking a thousand costs a thousand times that.
